Specification: This specification is a small TLC bug-reproduction model involving functions whose domain is a set containing a function value. It defines a function r, a set S as the set of all functions from {1} to {"A"}, assumes that S equals {r}, and then models a single variable v ranging over functions from S to {1}. The initial state sets v to the constant function on S with value 1, the next-state action performs a self-assignment update equivalent to stuttering via EXCEPT, and the spec adds weak fairness on Next. A trivial liveness property TRUE ~> TRUE is included specifically to trigger TLC's liveness checker, and the comments explain that the model is intended to expose a simulator/liveness bug related to FcnLambdaValue versus SetEnumValue handling.
